title: Apparently I like to make auto-play dungeon crawlers.  You play as a “shield boarding” wizard in this third and first person action RPG boomer shooter with simulated MMORPG elements.  I call it “Bellmourn : Velscour’s Throne”
author: batmessiah
selftext:
Some of you may have seen me post about my first game Velscour.  You can find out more about it over on r/velscour.  Bellmourn takes place 200 years after Velscour.  This time I went full 3D, with first and third person views.

This was done in Claude Code using Opus 5.5 and some Fable 5.2 and using Tripo to generate the models for me.  The game has full auto play, cause it’s a Velscour game, and people seem to enjoy watching my games play themselves.  I know I do.  It’s fun to actually play as well!

Anyone interested in trying this out when it’s ready for the public to play with?  I’m going to release it for free, cause why not?  I’m doing this for fun.
